text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Well, I had a solid trip, and I placed
pretty high!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I kept my cool throughout it too, so I
don't think
it was a bad race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...But of course, this isn't enough to
satisfy me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
There are always greater heights, and
every
second I waste is a second for the
competition to
climb ahead.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
There are always greater heights, and
every
second I waste is a second for the
competition to
climb ahead.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Should I? I guess it'd be nice to do that

sometimes...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: R-right. I really did my best...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, I can't do it! Anyway, I'm going to
take what
I learned today and apply it
to my next race!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Yeah... I have to keep moving forward!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I have to keep running until I am satisfied... until I become my ideal self!
